notes: Provider claude-cli uses the Claude Code CLI in headless mode (no API key; costs are the CLI's list-price estimates). Set LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or LLM_PROVIDER=openai (OPENAI_API_KEY) to switch; LLM_MODEL overrides every stage. Selection uses a cheaper model because it classifies many items; synthesis and writing use the strongest model.
